titles.romaji: Onii-chan no Koto nanka Zenzen Suki Janain Dakara ne!! Special
titles.native: お兄ちゃんのことなんかぜんぜん好きじゃないんだからねっ!!

description: According to the official website, the fifth volume of the Blu-ray and the DVD of Onii-chan no Koto nanka Zenzen Suki Janain Dakara ne!! will include an unaired episode. It will be released on July 6th.
